text:
Maria Chen: Quick POC readout from the last 3 weeks — dropping final numbers and proposed next steps.
Ajay Patel: awesome, paste the numbers pls
Maria Chen: here you go:
```
POC: support triage + doc retrieval (500k docs)
Duration: 3 weeks
Eval set: 1,200 prompts, 30 flows
Results:
- p95 latency: 270ms
- mean latency: 140ms
- throughput: 45 rps per GPU (dedicated config)
- token cost (hosted): $1.28 / 1k tokens
- retrieval + rerank accuracy: 87%
- hallucination rate (eval): 6.5%
- query distribution: 70% short, 30% long context
```
Derek Owens: nice. KV cache + continuous batching gave most wins. we saw tail latency spikes when concurrent long-context requests hit the same shard.
Derek Owens: quick ops note — switching to the 4-bit quantized variant drops cost ~20% but adds ~30ms p95 in our bench
Sylvia Park: security check: their InfoSec returned questionnaire, still outstanding: Q12 (KMS rotation policy) and Q19 (audit retention in private deployments). I pinged them earlier.
Jen Torres: from SE side — overall success criteria mapping:
- latency p95 < 300ms -> PASSED
- retrieval accuracy >= 85% -> PASSED
- cost per 1k tokens < $1.50 -> PASSED
- hallucination rate < 5% -> MARGINAL (6.5%)
So primary business KPIs met, hallucination needs follow-up.
Ajay Patel: customer is asking for a 90-day scale plan and pricing for Dedicated. can we give a recommended starter config + price delta vs hosted?
Derek Owens: recommend starting with 2x A10-equivalent GPUs reserved (handles ~90 rps with headroom). estimate: infra delta vs hosted ~ +$12k/mo for reserved + one-time onboarding fee ~$6k.
Maria Chen: propose contract SKUs:
- Starter Dedicated (2 GPUs) — throughput target 80rps, SLA 99.9
- Growth (4 GPUs) — >160rps, can autoscale burst to 8
Pricing: reference numbers above, need legal to sign off on onboarding fee.
Jen Torres: ops ask: SE can run a 2-week optimization sprint to cut hallucinations — tasks: reranker tuning, adversarial eval augmentation, prompt/template fixes, plus 1 week of regression monitoring.
Ajay Patel: ballpark cost for sprint?
Derek Owens: 2 engineer-weeks (prod+ml) + infra for extended eval -> estimate $18k labor + $3k extended infra + $9k for model variants/quants testing -> =~ $30k one-time
Sylvia Park: for contract we need to provide KMS rotation doc and audit log retention SLA. Maria, can you attach our standard PI and rotation doc to the pack?
Maria Chen: attaching shortly. also adding final slide deck for the customer readout and a short demo recording.
DeployBot: deployment v1 tagged: release/poceval-1769987654
Ajay Patel: next actions: @Jen to run the 2-week sprint scoping and produce formal quote; @Sylvia to resolve Q12/Q19 with customer's InfoSec; @Derek to produce perf/scale runbook and cost delta table; @Maria to send final readout deck and draft SAAS + Dedicated quote.
Jen Torres: will start scoping tomorrow, expect quote by EOD next Tue
Derek Owens: will run perf sweep this week and drop runbook by Friday
Sylvia Park: will follow up with their InfoSec, target to close questionnaire within 7 business days
Maria Chen: thanks team — I'll schedule a customer follow-up for the week after next to present results and the scale proposal. cc @Ajay for commercial
Ajay Patel: perfect. I'll prep the high-level commercial slide and lead the call. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: great, closing thread for internal sync. I'll update the folder with artifacts and move to customer-ready state when Jen's quote arrives.
